sections.title: Welcome
sections.content: Emotions are natural, but how we respond to them affects others.

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content: Dysregulation can lead to harmful behaviour, while regulation supports safety.

sections.title: Practical Skills
sections.content: Participants learn grounding, breathing, and pause techniques.

sections.title: Activity
sections.content: Identify one emotional trigger you experience.

sections.title: Reflection
sections.content: Regulation is a skill that improves with practice.
